page0.text:
...I'll go to the church.
It's irritating to have to ask that priest for help, but I'm not in a situation to be caring about such a thing.

page1.text:
Even if meeting up with Tohsaka and getting Saber back with her help is the best option, I have no way of finding her now that she's disappeared.
But that priest should know Tohsaka's whereabouts, and maybe even how to fight against Caster...

page2.text:
...My body feels heavy.
The wound on my shoulder aches with every step and raises my body temperature.

page3.text:
"...Guh... Haah... Haah... Haah... Haah..."
...This small hill looks like a wall now.
But, it'll end soon.
I'll be released from this weight once I go up the hill and reach the church.

page4.text:
The church looks as if it stands near the sky.
...Blood is dripping down my chest and armpits.

page5.text:
"Ugh... My wound opened up, damn it..."
I wouldn't think that my weak spirit made my wound worse.
My body should've been resting to start with.
Of course my wound would open up if I pushed myself to move.

page6.text:
"...But, if I see Kotomine, even that will..."
He might not be able to treat me, but I'm sure he at least has some medicine.
His role is to protect Masters who cannot fight anymore.
...This is ironic, but I have the right to receive protection from the church since I lost my Command Spell.

page7.text:
"...Haah."
...Only a bit further to the church.
I'm concerned about Tohsaka's whereabouts and about saving Saber, but for now, I just want to sit down and cool my heated body down.

page8.text:
The lights are out in the chapel.
The church is so quiet that I feel chills.

page9.text:
"Kotomine...?"
Kotomine is nowhere to be seen.
...I wouldn't think that he would be out.
I feel a person's presence.
The church is not deserted, as I hear some rustling sounds in the middle of the church past the chapel.

page10.text:
"...Huh?"
Something's off.
My impression and the truth are conflicting.

page11.text:
"Ungh... Ah, haah..."
...I can't gather my thoughts.
My wound is aching, and I'm unable to tell what's conflicting, what's going on, and where is dangerous.

page12.text:
"...An earthquake?"
I stop before sitting down in a chair.
A shelf might've collapsed from the earthquake, as I hear ceramics breaking and Kotomine's voice.

page13.text:
"...He's in the back."
The lights are out in the chapel.
In that case, today might be a day off for the church, and the priest might be in the back.
I don't know if churches have days off, I wouldn't think that it would be accepting visitors if the lights are out.

page14.text:
"Ugh... On a day like this?"
It's hard to keep walking any longer without any treatment, but I can't collapse into the chair.
I have to see the priest to have this wound treated and to find out where Tohsaka is.

page15.text:
When I exit the chapel, there is a courtyard.
I couldn't tell from the outside, but there seems to be a plaza set up in the center of the building.
The corridor surrounding the yard is intricate and reminds me of a monastery I saw in a book...

page16.text:
"...Huh?"
I stop.
I feel like there was something stuck to the pillar I just passed by that shouldn't be there...

page17.text: "...Oh. I thought I would see you again, but I didn't think it would be this soon."

page18.text:
"Guh...!"
I almost fall as I turn around.
I'm unsteady on my feet and lean on the wall of the church to prevent myself from falling.

page19.text:
"...Why... Are you here...?"
Painfully...
I bear the pain that digs into my shoulder and stare at the shadow in front of me.

page20.text:
"That is my line. I thought that you wouldn't be able to move for a while with that wound, but you were more than I expected, boy."
The purple robe comes closer.
I...
